passkeys.description: Confirm sign-in with your fingerprint, face, device PIN or a security key.
passkeys.addIntro: Give it a name so you can tell your passkeys apart. Your browser then asks where to save it.
passkeys.unsupportedBrowser: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.otherAddress: Passkeys can be added when GHOST is opened at: {{origins}}
passkeys.notConfigured: Passkeys need GHOST to run on HTTPS with a domain name (or on localhost). Your administrator sets the address in FRONTEND_URL.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: If you lose your phone or passkey, sign in with one of these. Each code works once.
recovery.dialogIntro: If you lose access to your authenticator app or passkey, you can sign in with one of these codes. Each works once. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager.
recovery.dialogWarning: You will not see these codes again.
recovery.fileHeader: GHOST recovery codes for {{username}}, created {{date}}. Each code works once.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: For the MCP server and scripts. A token acts as you, with your role and project access, and skips two-step verification, so keep it secret. Revoke it here when it is no longer needed.
tokens.newWarning: You will not see this token again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
tokens.mcpHint: For the MCP server, set GHOST_API_TOKEN to this value.

policy.title: Server policy
policy.requireLabel: Require two-step verification for every user
policy.requireDescription: Applies to sign-ins with a GHOST password: users without two-step verification are asked to set it up the next time they sign in, before they can use GHOST. Single sign-on users get two-step verification from the identity provider instead.
policy.ssoOnly: Everyone signs in with single sign-on (password sign-in is turned off), so two-step verification is set up and enforced at your identity provider.

gate.title: Set up two-step verification
gate.description: Your administrator requires two-step verification. Add an authenticator app or a passkey to continue.

errors.codeInvalid: That code is not valid. Check the time on your device and try again.
errors.signInExpired: Sign-in expired. Enter your password again.
errors.requiredByPolicy: Two-step verification is required on this server. Add another method before removing this one.
errors.enableOwnFirst: Set up two-step verification for your own account first.
errors.passkeyOrigin: Passkeys are not available at this address.
errors.passkeyExpired: The passkey request expired. Try again.
errors.passkeyInvalid: The passkey could not be verified.
errors.passkeyNone: None of your passkeys works at this address.
errors.setupExpired: Setup expired. Close this and start again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.reauthRequired: For your security, sign in again with single sign-on first, then create the token.

security.ssoTwoFactor: You sign in with single sign-on, so two-step verification is handled by your identity provider.

records.title: Saved records
records.help: Results from integrated tools, kept exactly as the service returned them. Open a record to see every field; any value in it can be added to the OSINT data.
records.empty: No saved records. In a tool search, tick "Keep full record" on a result to save it here.
records.pickHint: Use + next to a value to add it to the OSINT data.
records.addedExisting: {{value}} was already in the OSINT data; this record is now one of its sources.

reasons.rate_limited: the geocoding provider is limiting requests, try again in a minute
reasons.timeout: the geocoding provider didn't answer in time
reasons.service_error: the geocoding provider returned an error
reasons.empty: there is no address to look up
